description: Fetch the configured design fields for your GrowSurf program, including GrowSurf Window content, colors, sharing sections, participant avatars under `participantAvatarStyle`, referred-visitor content such as the Claim Offer Popup, the website widget under `widget`, the participant Traffic report under `trafficInsights` (it starts on for new affiliate programs and hidden for referral programs, and every setting is returned with its default copy), participant sign-in copy under `login`, payout-destination confirmation page copy under `payoutDestinationConfirmation`, and country-name overrides under `countryLabels`. `participantAvatarStyle` is `CHARACTERS`, `INITIALS`, `ANIMALS`, or `GRADIENT`; missing or unknown values mean `INITIALS`. The confirmation section is omitted when no confirmation fields are stored. Stored `null` fields are returned as `null`; omitted and `null` fields use localized defaults. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_get_campaign_design

outputSchema.description: A program's design configuration, organized by section. The sections available depend on the program type. `GET` returns configured fields; `payoutDestinationConfirmation` is omitted when no confirmation fields are stored. Stored `null` fields are returned as `null`; omitted and `null` fields use localized defaults. `PATCH` back only the sections or fields you want to change.

affiliateSummary.description: Affiliate programs only. The affiliate's row of summary tiles (clicks, revenue, payouts).

commissions.description: Affiliate programs only. The Commissions section of the participant portal.

countryLabels.description: Participant-facing country-name overrides keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example `GB`). Each label replaces the default country name wherever participants pick a country, such as payout and tax forms. Overrides merge per code on `PATCH`; `null` (or the default name) restores a code's default. Only overridden codes are returned.

header.description: Header content for participants (`postText`) and non-participants (`preText`).

landingPages.description: Portal and landing pages: company info, `content`, `styles`, third-party script ids, and SEO meta tags.

leaderboard.description: The leaderboard section: labels, selectors, and name masking.

login.description: The returning-participant sign-in form plus its success, resend, validation, and error text.

buttonText.description: Text on the button that requests a sign-in link.

cooldown.description: Message shown when another link cannot be requested yet.

description.description: Instructions shown below the sign-in heading.

fieldLabel.description: Label for the participant email field.

fieldPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the participant email field.

heading.description: Heading shown at the top of the sign-in form.

invalidEmail.description: Validation message shown for an invalid email address.

invalidLink.description: Message shown when a sign-in link is invalid or expired.

resendPrompt.description: Prompt shown beside the resend action.

resent.description: Confirmation shown after another link is requested.

serverError.description: Message shown when GrowSurf cannot request a sign-in link.

successBody.description: Message shown after a sign-in link is requested.

successHeading.description: Heading shown after a sign-in link is requested.

participantAvatarStyle.description: How participant avatars appear in the GrowSurf Window. New programs use `CHARACTERS`; missing or unknown stored values return `INITIALS`.

participantSettings.description: The participant's account settings area (logout, PayPal and Wise payout confirmation/status messages, tax details).

payoutDestinationConfirmation.description: Customizable text for the payout-destination confirmation page opened from payout integration cards. One shared set applies to every enabled payout provider. Provider-aware text may use `{{payoutProvider}}`; omitted and `null` fields use localized defaults.

button.description: Text on the confirmation form's submit button.

claimPending.description: Message shown while GrowSurf finishes confirming the payout destination.

emailAgainLabel.description: Label for confirming the payout email.

emailAgainPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the payout-email confirmation field.

emailLabel.description: Label for the participant's payout email field.

emailPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the payout email field.

errorMessages.description: Custom validation and confirmation-link status messages.

alreadyConfirmed.description: Message shown when the destination is no longer awaiting confirmation.

emailMismatch.description: Message shown when the email entries do not match.

generic.description: Provider-neutral fallback message for another unusable-link state.

invalidEmail.description: Message shown for an invalid email address.

tokenExpired.description: Message shown when the confirmation link expired.

tokenUsed.description: Message shown when the confirmation link was already used.

headline.description: Page heading above the confirmation form.

legalNameLabel.description: Label for the payout recipient's legal name.

legalTypeBusiness.description: Option text for a business payout recipient.

legalTypeIndividual.description: Option text for an individual payout recipient.

legalTypeLabel.description: Label for choosing the payout recipient type.

success.description: Message shown after payout details are confirmed.

payouts.description: Affiliate programs only. The Payouts section of the participant portal.

referralStatus.description: The section listing who a participant invited and each invite's progress. `revealInviteEmails` lets a signed-in participant see original invitation addresses when disclosure permission was recorded. Private invites and full email masking keep addresses hidden. Other referral addresses stay masked. `revealInviteEmailText` supplies the sign-in prompt; `followUp` supplies the invitation follow-up labels and messages.

referralSummary.description: Referral programs only. The participant's row of summary tiles (clicks, leads, referrals, rewards).

referredExperience.description: The banner, headline, and Claim Offer Popup shown to a visitor who arrives through a referral link. The popup is available for referral and affiliate programs.

isOfferPopupConfettiEnabled.description: Whether to show confetti after a claim.

isOfferPopupEnabled.description: Whether referred visitors see the Claim Offer Popup.

isOfferPopupOverlayDimmed.description: Whether a centered popup dims the page behind it.

isOfferPopupReferrerImageShown.description: Whether to show the referrer's profile image.

isOfferPopupShownOnAllPages.description: Whether the popup can appear on every installed page.

offerPopupSecondaryLinkUrl.description: Optional post-claim link destination. When saving, use `http://` or `https://`. Send `null` or an empty string to clear it.

offerPopupThankYouText.description: Message shown after the offer is saved.

resources.description: Participant Resources presentation settings: visibility, title, link and copy labels, the message shown when nothing is published, and the section icon. Resource items use the program Resource tools.

rewards.description: Heading, icon, and empty-state text of the rewards panel.

share.description: Share channels, invite settings, and share-button styling.

signup.description: Signup form fields, GDPR consent, and button and login text.

stats.description: The participant's referral-progress stats panel. Only `title` is editable.

theme.description: Visual theme styling (colors, shadows, and similar).

referredExperienceOfferPopup.description: Paid-plan color settings for the Claim Offer Popup.

widget.description: Paid-plan color settings for the website widget.

backgroundColor.description: Fill color of the button, and of the card's own button.

borderRadius.description: Corner rounding, as a CSS length such as `12px`.

color.description: Text and drawing color on the button, and on the card's own button.

trafficInsights.description: The Traffic report participants can open from the GrowSurf window: visits to their share link over time and where those visits came from. It starts on for new affiliate programs and hidden for referral programs. Every setting is returned, with the default copy for anything not changed. Labels cannot be blank.

allLinksLabel.description: The share link picker option that combines all of the participant's links.

backLinkText.description: The text of the link back from the report.

breakdowns.description: The tables that show where visits came from: `utm`, `referrer`, `destination`, `geo`, `technology`, and `trigger`. Each has `isVisible` and `label`; some also name their levels under `levels` or their fixed rows under `values`.

breakdownsTitle.description: The heading above the breakdown table.

dateRangeLabels.description: The date range picker labels, keyed by `LAST_7_DAYS`, `LAST_30_DAYS`, `LAST_90_DAYS`, and `ALL_TIME`.

defaultDateRange.description: The date range the report opens with.

emptyState.description: The message shown before the participant's link has any visits. Can be empty.

isPublicDisplayed.description: Whether participants can open the Traffic report.

messages.description: Messages shown when the report cannot show everything: `error`, `unavailable`, `partial`, `partialFrom` (`{{date}}` is replaced with the first available date), `breakdownPartial`, and `breakdownEmpty`.

metrics.description: The two visit counts at the top of the report, `visits` and `uniqueVisitors`, each with `isVisible`, `label`, and `helperText`.

notSetLabel.description: The row name for visits that have no value for the chosen breakdown.

trafficForLabel.description: The label in front of the share link picker.

viewTrafficInsightsLinkText.description: The text of the row or tab that opens the report.

visitsOverTimeTitle.description: The heading above the visits chart.

widget.description: The website widget — the invite that sits in a corner of the customer's own site. It renders as a button or as a card, and its card folds back into the button when a visitor closes it. Both audience switches start off, so a program shows nothing until one is turned on.

appearance.description: `BUTTON` is a single button in the corner. `CARD` is a small card with a heading, a line of text, and a button, which a visitor can close.

artImageUrl.description: The picture shown at the top of the card.

buttonText.description: The label on the card's button, which opens the program.

icon.description: An uploaded image instead of a `markKey` drawing. `CUSTOM` uses `iconImageUrl`; `NONE` shows no image. `DEFAULT` is the old GrowSurf image: a program already set to it keeps it and can read it back, but it cannot be set. Requires a paid plan.

iconImageUrl.description: The uploaded image, used when `icon` is `CUSTOM`. Requires a paid plan.

isArtShown.description: Whether the card shows a picture above its text. Ignored by the button.

isHiddenOnMobile.description: Whether to leave phones alone. On small screens the card fills the bottom of the page.

isShownToNewVisitors.description: Whether people who have not joined the program see the widget.

isShownToParticipants.description: Whether people who have already joined see the widget.

markKey.description: The small drawing on the widget. It takes the colour chosen for the widget, so it matches on any background. `null` for no drawing.

newVisitorDescription.description: The line under the heading for people who have not joined. Card only.

newVisitorText.description: What people who have not joined read. It is the button's label, and the card's heading.

offsetEdge.description: How far in from the top or bottom edge, in pixels, following `placement`. Raise it to clear a chat button that already sits in that corner.

offsetSide.description: How far in from the left or right edge, in pixels, following `placement`. For a centered placement it becomes an even gap on both sides.

pageRules.description: Which pages the widget appears on. This controls the widget only — referral tracking, embedded elements, and opening the window from the site's own code keep working on every page where GrowSurf is installed.

mode.description: `ALL` shows it everywhere. `ONLY` shows it just on the listed pages. `EXCEPT` shows it everywhere but the listed pages. With no pages listed, `ONLY` and `EXCEPT` behave as `ALL`.

patterns.description: The pages to match. Use `*` to stand in for anything, as in `/portal/*`. A path on its own, such as `/pricing`, matches that path on every installed domain.

participantDescription.description: The line under the heading for people who have already joined. Card only.

participantText.description: What people who have already joined read. It is the button's label, and the card's heading.

placement.description: Which corner or edge of the page the widget sits against.

returnAfterDays.description: Days before the card is offered again to someone who closed it. Until then they keep the button, so they can still open the program. `0` never offers it again.

reveal.description: What the element waits for before it appears: the page loading (`IMMEDIATE`) or the visitor scrolling halfway down the page (`SCROLL`). `revealDelaySeconds` then counts from that moment. `DELAY` is accepted for older programs and behaves as `IMMEDIATE`.

revealDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the `reveal` trigger before showing the element. `0` shows it the moment the trigger fires.

window.description: Layout of the GrowSurf window (`navigationMode`: `TABS` or `LIST`).

title: Get Program Design
